config.title: Generation Config
config.subtitle: Global defaults for AI generation
config.contextSizeDesc: Total tokens the AI sees per turn: persona, world, lorebook, and chat history combined (4,096 - 2,000,000). Heavier setup leaves less room for chat history.
config.reasoningDesc: Controls how much the AI "thinks" before responding. None is fastest, higher levels may improve complex reasoning but slow generation.
config.streamingDesc: Show AI responses as they generate
config.memoryDesc: How many tokens the AI remembers (higher = more credits)
config.repetitionPenaltyDesc: Discourage repeated phrases and sentence patterns (1.00 = off; Kimi default 1.08)

reasoningOptions.lowDesc: A balanced fast default for simple tasks.
reasoningOptions.mediumDesc: More deliberate reasoning for most sessions.
reasoningOptions.highDesc: Deepest reasoning, slower but more thoughtful.

checkIn.supplyInfoBody: Every day at 20:00 UTC — the same reset as daily check-in, the same for everyone — we check your balance. If it's below your plan's floor, we auto-refill to the floor. Above floor → nothing happens.
checkIn.supplyInfoNote: Note: this is "restore to floor", not "add X to balance". E.g. balance 750 → 800 only credits +50.

apiKeys.ollamaHelpTitle: Hosted Yumina needs a reachable Ollama URL
apiKeys.ollamaHelpStep1: Expose your Ollama server with a public HTTPS tunnel or reverse proxy, for example:
apiKeys.ollamaHelpStep2: Paste the tunnel root URL here. Do not add /api/tags or /api/chat.
apiKeys.ollamaHelpStep3: Click Connect. Yumina will fetch /api/tags and use /api/chat when you chat.
apiKeys.ollamaHelpStep4: Keep the tunnel URL private, and stop or protect the tunnel when you are not using it.
apiKeys.ollamaLocalhostWarning: localhost only works when the Yumina server is running on the same machine as Ollama. On yumina.io, use the public tunnel URL instead.

qualifiedReferral.qualify: New accounts: 3 completed AI play turns or 10 active gameplay minutes, plus a return visit.
qualifiedReferral.limit: Up to {{count}} rewards · {{amount}} Mushies per campaign. No monthly reset.
qualifiedReferral.returnRule: Within {{days}} days of redeeming your code, your friend must reach the play threshold and play again at least 24 hours after their first play. Browsing, idle time and Studio do not qualify. Only new accounts created during this campaign qualify.
qualifiedReferral.slots: {{count}} campaign slots available. A slot is reserved when an eligible friend redeems your code; it is released if they do not qualify in time. Reserved rewards can finish qualifying after the campaign closes.
qualifiedReferral.expiry: Rewards go to Bonus, not Monthly or Saved. Each reward expires at the end of the following reward month. Your wallet shows its exact local expiry time. Existing Saved credits keep their terms.
qualifiedReferral.transition: From {{date}}, new referrals use these rules instead of the Mushie/Gold milestone ladder. Previously earned Mushies, Gold days and all-time achievement progress are preserved.
qualifiedReferral.awaitReturn: Needs a play return 24+ hours after first play
